# Columbia University Irving Medical Center

> CUIMC is a leading academic medical center in Manhattan integrating clinical care, research, and medical education across five schools including medicine, dentistry, nursing, and public health.

Columbia University Irving Medical Center (CUIMC) serves as the clinical, research, and educational hub for Columbia University's health sciences enterprise in Washington Heights, New York. The institution operates through affiliated hospitals across the Northeast and maintains a strong commitment to community engagement, diversity, and faculty development.

## Key Topics

- Vagelos College of Physicians and Surgeons
